create_opengauss_client: create an OpenGaussClient instance to initialize a vector database connection with pgvector support
insert_vector_items: insert a list of vector items with text and metadata into a named OpenGauss collection
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in a collection using cosine distance and return ranked results
delete_collection_items: delete items from an OpenGauss collection by ids or metadata filter criteria
reset_opengauss_collection: reset an OpenGauss client by deleting all document chunks from the database
